scope: selected author UI strings only; runtime not inspected

selected_strings.ftbquests.quest.misc.repeat_cooldown.too:
Only applies if 'Repeatable Quest' is true.
The delay in seconds between claiming all the rewards for the quest and being able to redo the quest's tasks.
selected_strings.ftbquests.quest.misc.exclusive.desc: Completing this makes other branches unavailable
selected_strings.ftbquests.quest.min_required_dependencie: If you set this to anything more than 0, it becomes an OR quest, where only certain amount of dependencies is required for it to unlock
selected_strings.ftbquests.pinned.pinned_exclude_flexible:
If true, quests which are only startable due to flexible mode (so not completable yet) are not shown in the tracker
If false, all startable quests are shown
